description: This file defines a class CopyTableWorker that extends SwingWorker to copy table data to the system clipboard in a Java Swing application.

classes.name: CopyTableWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker that copies table content to the system clipboard in a background thread.

methods.name: CopyTableWorker
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the worker with the table to copy.

methods.name: doInBackground
methods.description: Performs the copying of table data to the system clipboard.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Resets the cursor to default after copying completes.
